description:
The agent must execute the full 8-step workflow from SKILL.md:
1. Locate the three input files in /workspace/task_inputs/.
2. Call `python3 /workspace/projects/investment-post-management-report-updater/scripts/parse_financial_data.py --file .../云启科技2024Q4财务报表.xlsx` to extract structured JSON with revenue=6800, net_profit=1193.4, total_assets=13090, etc.
3. Call `parse_docx.py --file .../云启科技2024Q4访谈纪要.docx` and `parse_docx.py --file .../云启科技2024Q3投后管理报告.docx` to extract text content from both DOCX files.
4. Using the financial analysis guide formulas, compute: YoY revenue growth = (6800-5200)/5200 ≈ 30.8%, QoQ = (6800-5950)/5950 ≈ 14.3%, net margin = 1193.4/6800 ≈ 17.6%. Write a financial analysis paragraph including these figures.
5. Synthesize business update text from the interview transcript, including key facts: 385 customers, ACV 1200万, v3.2 release, 政务云 3 provincial clients, B轮 5000万, 186 employees.
6. Synthesize industry update from interview: 580亿 market, 18% growth, 7% market share, competitor price cuts, 工信部 policy.
7. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: Call `generate_report.py` with all 6 required CLI arguments. `--financial-data` must be valid JSON (either a file path to the parsed JSON or a JSON string) - plain text will cause json.loads() to fail. `--template` must point to the Q3 report. `--output` must be `云启科技2024Q4投后管理报告.docx`. The script internally searches for Chinese section keywords ('财务数据', '经营情况', '行业') to inject content - if the agent generates the DOCX manually without calling this script, it will miss the timestamp injection.
8. The output report must contain: the update timestamp header, Q4 revenue 6800, net profit 1193, growth rate percentages (~30% YoY or ~14% QoQ), interview-sourced business keywords (385, v3.2, 政务云), industry keywords (580亿, 18%), and balance sheet figures.
